title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-ps69: SOS POST test asserts stale CHANGED code
description:
Commit c585073 changed `SosResource.render_post` to return `aiocoap.CREATED` (2.01) instead of `aiocoap.CHANGED` (2.04) to match spec §18.4.3 (which says `Response: 2.01 Created`). However, the corresponding test at `python/tests/coap/test_sos_resource.py:117` still asserts `resp.code == aiocoap.CHANGED`, so the test will fail.

Fix: update line 117 from `assert resp.code == aiocoap.CHANGED` to `assert resp.code == aiocoap.CREATED`.
